description.value: All material flows that contribute to more than 1% of the total mass, energy, or environmental impact of the system have been considered in the LCA, and all datasets chosen for the modules A1-A3 refer to the Rest-of-the-World or to China.  Transport distances for all raw materials (raw materials, operating materials, packaging) could be recorded. A payload factor of 50 percent was used for all truck transports (suppliers, disposal transports, and internal transports), which corresponds to a full delivery and empty return trip.

timeRepresentativenessDescription.value: All product-specific and process-specific data was provided by the manufacturer for the 2022 operating year and is therefore up-to-date.

descriptionOfRestrictions.value: The input data are representative for Laminated glass , a product of Tianjin North Glass Industrial Technical Co., Ltd.. The data are representative globally, since RoW (Rest of the World) EcoInvent datasets were mainly used, which are most conservative and therefore applicable to other regions. Waste scenario data are representative for Europe as well as other regions where comparable waste processing technologies are used (e.g. U.S.A., Canada).

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value: The laminated glass assembly consists of one or more sheets of glass and/or plastic glazing sheet material joined together with one or more inner-layers. The laminated glass consist of two 6 mm glasses, separated by a 1.52 mm layer of Polyvinyl butyral of 13.52 mm thickness. The laminated glass is always to be used as the architectural glass. The laminated glass can block sound waves and maintain a quiet and comfortable room environment. It can also reduce the transmission of sunlight and reduce the energy consumption for air conditioning. Its unique UV filtering function not only protects people’s skin, but also prevents valuable furniture and displays from fading.  The weight of the product packaging is 1.8 kg/m². Ready-made glass panels are send to the factory, where they are first cut. After that, edges are ground and subsequently glass panes are tempered in a heat soaking process. Eventually the glass is laminated and packed on wooden pallets.

technologicalApplicability.value: According to EN 1279:2018 the main intended uses of laminated glass are installations in windows, doors, curtain walling, bonded glazing for doors, windows and curtain walling, roofs and partitions. The achieving of the requirements of this standard means that the laminated glass meets the needs of the intended uses and ensures through the conformity assessment that the visual, energy acoustic and safety parameters do not change significantly over time.
